authority_basis.binding_clause: C2S-SPTOI-WP3 / G3-ALG: Replay exact-source fixture corpus; clean-process + checkpoint/restart logical equivalence; C2LIB typed handoff parity where exact source exists; independent algorithmic review records COMPLETE or PARTIAL_SOURCE_LIMITED.
Required modes are historical fixture, fresh-process and checkpoint/restart replay, serialized output identity and typed handoff surface parity across the complete frozen comparison scope.
Exact P3-R5-T2-S2 implementation source requires deterministic serialization and identity and preserves gap, chronology, warmup, relation, open-development and enum/value ordering.

positive_findings: Exact P3-R5-T2-S2 implementation source and S2 succession-ledger mechanics
C2EXP-0008 and C2EXP-0008-R2 Pine source surfaces
Source-exact C2LIB/C2E-LIB typed consumer call surfaces
historical_stream_export_search.negative_finding: No complete historical per-case typed stream, trigger-mask stream or append-only succession-ledger export was found.
historical_stream_export_search.reason: The evidence proves that the typed and ledger mechanisms existed and were consumed, but it does not prove that complete per-case serialized stream exports were retained as artifacts.

contract_determination.question: If no historical stream exports are found, can exact-source trajectories plus exact implementation plus source-exact terminal goldens plus regenerated deterministic typed-stream parity support WP3 COMPLETE?
rationale: The ratified WP3 clause requires replay of the exact-source fixture corpus and deterministic cross-mode equivalence; it does not require a pre-existing historical serialized-stream artifact.
The phrase 'C2LIB typed handoff parity where exact source exists' makes exact source availability the boundary for typed handoff parity, not the existence of an archived output stream.
The exact P3-R5-T2-S2 implementation is source-bound and the exact C2LIB typed call surface is available, so deterministic streams may be regenerated from exact-source trajectories.

Source-exact terminal goldens anchor historical results, while full regenerated stream comparison across every parity-contract scope item proves chronology, ledger order and serialization determinism.
Independent G3-ALG review remains the blocking adjudicator and must record COMPLETE.
complete_conditions: The exact original trajectories and runtime bindings for the five divergent cases are recovered without interpolation or inferred repair.
All 25 admitted trajectories qualify as exact-source fixtures; the 20 currently aggregate-concordant candidate trajectories must remain byte-preserved and pass the final source-binding review.
Every case matches all 32 source-exact terminal census fields, including object, role, lifecycle, relation, transition, compound, interaction, ledger and integrity goldens.
The exact source-bound P3-R5-T2-S2 implementation is replayed in historical, fresh-process and checkpoint/restart modes.
Canonical typed bytes and identities are equal across replay modes for every case.

Formation/object identity, lifecycle transitions, boundary succession, relation/envelope, atomic/compound/open state, snapshot trigger masks, append-only succession ledger and break/warmup behaviour are all compared without narrowing.
C2LIB EngineR4/newEngineR4/stepR4 typed handoff output is byte-identical to the primary reference API on every case.
Any historical typed or succession-ledger export discovered later is treated as an additional mandatory external oracle and any divergence quarantines the implementation.
not_sufficient: Terminal aggregate goldens without exact-source trajectories
Regenerated stream self-consistency without exact source-to-engine audit and terminal-golden agreement
Twenty aggregate-concordant cases used to infer or repair any of the five divergent trajectories
A reduced comparison scope, relaxed identity criterion or missing typed handoff check

supersedes: The presumption in C2S_SPTOI_WP3_CANDIDATE_SOURCE_ASSESSMENT_R10S2_v0_1.json that complete historical expected stream exports are necessarily required.
Any source request wording that treats unproven historical stream exports as co-equal with the five irreplaceable original trajectories.
does_not_supersede: The quarantine of R10S2_TRADINGVIEW_RAW.csv as non-exact for five cases.
The full C2CSM reference parity comparison scope.
The prohibition on PARTIAL_SOURCE_LIMITED without operator instruction.
